newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE Energie sees increased 95/96 profits.
newsitem.headline: RWE Energie sees increased 95/96 profits.

text.p: Germany's biggest electricity company RWE Energie said on Thursday that pre-tax profit grew to 485 million marks in the year to the end of June 1996 from 433 million marks last time.
The profit increase came despite a drop in sales. Turnover at RWE's main subsidiary fell to 16.4 billion marks from 16.7 billion marks a year previously, the group said in a statement.
RWE Energie said that it managed to report higher profits because of improved efficiencies and successful cost management. The group said that the profit trend in the current year was stable.
During the financial year RWE Energie generated 124,300 billion kilowatts of electricity, down from last year's figure of 125,600 billion kilowatts, due to weak economic development in the period.
The number of employees fell by 700 to 21,769 people, while the group's total investment was 1.1 billion marks.
